statistical_unit: 24 geometry-level paired effects; policies, pairs, prefixes, arms and terminal protocols are not independent samples.

mechanism_stage.accounting: Included once in completion.new_work; do not add again.

analytic_truth.accounting: Stage breakdowns are already included where metered in the finalized ledger; do not add them to recorded_total_function_calls again.

costs.interpretation: Physical calls count paid observations once; each protocol retains its logical consumption. Analytic truth calls and CPU are separate. Unknown totals are not zero; historical accounts are references, not additional current spending.

limits: Only the registered fresh geometries enter estimates; source groups and opened cohorts are not additional observations.
C and signed G under the old default terminal are reported together. R retains lost-certificate losses even when G is zero.
Undefined initial baselines and failed executions remain null. Full-cohort estimates are null if incomplete; defined-subset denominators remain explicit.
Family summaries and largest-positive-geometry removal are descriptive; no task is removed from the registered primary estimate.
One stream per known-family geometry does not establish within-geometry noise stability or unseen-family generalization.
All other controls and the new terminal are secondary; no secondary result replaces the AP-old primary.

aggregate.statistical_unit: Registered task geometry. Pair rates are computed within each geometry before summaries.
